 Alex Cooper gives birth to first baby with husband Matt Kaplan 
 By 
 Riley Cardoza 
 Published 
 Oct. 20, 2026, 9:16 a.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source 
 Call her Mommy!
 Alex Cooper has given birth , welcoming her and husband Matt Kaplan’s first baby.
 The “Call Her Daddy” podcast host, 31, announced her infant son’s arrival with an Instagram photo Tuesday.

 The picture, captioned with a blue heart, showed the little one resting in a fuzzy gray outfit, his face out of frame.
 Cooper went public with her pregnancy in May, debuting her bump in an Instagram slideshow.
 “Our family 🤍,” she captioned the maternity shoot snaps at the time.
 Cooper opened up to her listeners the following month about when she started to “get the itch” to become a mom.
 9 
 “Our family,” she captioned her Instagram baby bump debut. Instagram/@alexandracooper 
 9 
 Cooper said in June that she “got the itch” after doing some “travel” and “accomplish[ing] certain goals.” Instagram/@alexandracooper

 This happened “as more and more time went on, [the couple] traveled and [they] accomplished certain goals [they] had set.”
 Cooper recalled telling her partner, “The only thing that feels like it’s truly missing right now is a child and starting our own family together. And I have never felt more ready.”
 The former Barstool Sports personality told Kaplan the news by handing him a positive pregnancy test, telling him she hoped he liked his “gift” because it “was non-refundable.”
 She remembered, “He looked so shocked. And then we both started crying. We didn’t even say anything in that moment. There were just no words. He pulled me onto his lap. We were hugging and kissing and crying.”
 9 
 At the time, she told Kaplan, “I have never felt more ready.” Instagram/@alexandracooper 
 9 
 Cooper ultimately told her Unwell Network co-founder they were expecting by handing him a positive pregnancy test. Instagram/@alexandracooper 
 The couple subsequently “had the most incredible night that [she] will forever and always cherish.”
 As previously reported, Cooper and Kaplan had been battling rumors that their marriage was on the rocks , which she addressed during the episode .
 “No one in our life, our closest friends, our family, is wondering those things,” she said, calling the speculation “an odd part of the job that [she doesn’t] enjoy.”
 Cooper and Kaplan met on a Zoom call in 2020 and started dating after a business dinner.
 9 
 After Cooper’s reveal, the couple “had the most incredible night that [she] will forever and always cherish.” Instagram/@alexandracooper 
 9 
 Cooper and Kaplan started dating in 2020, got engaged three years later and wed in 2024. Instagram/@alexandracooper 
 The businessman popped the question in 2023, and the Unwell Network co-founders walked down the aisle in Mexico in April of the following year.
 In 2025, Cooper explained why she wasn’t yet “ready” to have kids.
 “I really wanted to prioritize our relationship,” she said on her podcast. “I wanted to prioritize work and I wanted, honestly, most importantly, to prioritize myself. And overall, I just felt like I needed a little bit more time … to tackle motherhood.”
